children.name:
Coordinate the next home-cinema appointment and let every household
      member cast or change one film vote while voting is open.
terms:
"
      Coordinate the next home-cinema appointment and let every household
      member cast or change one film vote while voting is open.
      "
"The latest vote from a member replaces that member's earlier vote."
"Members may reconsider before the poll closes."
"Do not count multiple active votes from one member."
"A tie is resolved by the stable candidate order from OpenVoting."
"Closing a poll must always yield one predictable film."
"Do not choose a tied winner randomly."
